name: Freeze the linter rule-set baseline and close the stale in-flight branches
description:
Part of the rule-unification track (`doc/plans/rule-unification.md` in `shoptet/partner-cli`; this repo's index is `doc/plans/README.md`; this specific slice is `doc/plans/rule-unification-a0.md`). This is chunk 1 of 6, wave 1 (no dependencies) — the extraction chunks (2, 3, 6) need a fixed baseline to preserve/publish, and the equality test (5) needs something concrete to compare against.

## Why this chunk is small

The plan originally worried that 5 open branches were editing the very rule config the later chunks extract, so extraction against a moving target would have no fixed baseline. That risk has been checked against the actual remote state:

Only `fix/large-file-inline-comments` ever touched severity mapping / `max-lines` per the plan's own table, and it's confirmed dead (merge-base equals its own tip — `main` never merged it, and it has no commits `main` lacks). So there is no live rule-config change in flight, and no `max-lines`/severity decision to make here.

Branch: https://github.com/shoptet/addon-repository-actions-config/tree/fix/large-file-inline-comments (no open PR).

## Scope

- Close all 5 branches, noting in each closure that it is stale/superseded/already-contained — so a later reader doesn't mistake an abandoned branch for pending work. Tell whoever owns `fix/large-file-inline-comments` that an extraction is coming, so no one is surprised.
- Take a rule-set snapshot: the exact `rule@severity` set produced by `node test/selftest.js` + `linter_review_tool/test-cases/expected.json`, run on current `main` as-is (no rule-config changes needed first). This is the baseline chunk 2 must preserve and chunks 3/6 must publish.
- Fix the `README.md` Node-version inconsistency: it currently states default `'22'` in two places (lines ~188, ~199-206) while `.github/workflows/default.workflow.yml` (line 11) sets `'24'` after PR #13.

## Blast radius

The track order is fixed — **A0 → A1 → A2 → B1 → B2 → B3 → A3/B4** — and every slice must leave both repos green and shippable, a hard constraint per the plan. `A0` is first, so nothing else on the track can start: not the ESLint 8 → 9 flat-config port, not the package extraction/publish (npm access tracked separately in [CZ3TDR1-636](https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3TDR1-636)), and none of `shoptet/partner-cli`'s B1–B4. Downstream, `B3` deletes this repo's 12 rules (including `shoptet/datalayer-schema` and `shoptet/no-load-order-globals`) on the strength of the published packages covering them — the frozen baseline is what makes that deletion checkable.

## Proof (definition of done)

- All 5 branches closed, each with a one-line reason.
- `node test/selftest.js` green on `main`, and the resulting `rule@severity` set written down in the PR as the frozen baseline.
- README's Node-version inconsistency fixed to say `'24'`.

## Review checklist

- Confirm the frozen baseline was produced by _running_ the selftest, not by reading `expected.json`.
- Confirm the baseline includes stylelint and HTML findings, not just ESLint — all three linters feed one gate.
- Confirm `default.workflow.yml` still exposes the `node_version` input defaulting to `'24'`.

## Research grounding

Verified against current HEAD `594dcc3` (2 commits past the plan's measurement point `cd4c4d4`, both docs-only, so measurements still hold):

- `linter_review_tool/test/selftest.js` (415 lines) + `test-cases/expected.json` (205 lines) exist as described.
- Branch divergence table above verified via `git rev-list --count` and `git merge-base` against `origin/main`.
